mapper.insert: insert into settlement (order_id, provider_id, order_amount, platform_fee, net_amount, frozen_reason) values (#{orderId}, #{providerId}, #{orderAmount}, #{platformFee}, #{netAmount}, #{frozenReason})
mapper.update: update settlement set status='SETTLED', settled_at=now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: select * from settlement where status='PENDING' order by id asc limit 100
select count(*) from settlement where status='PENDING'
